classifications.evidence_quote: We could not finish account setup because the invitation link expired before our admin used it.
The setup checklist doesn’t explain whether workspace creation comes before importing team members.
Our first-time admin needed three separate calls to understand how roles and permissions work during setup.
I signed up yesterday but the welcome screen never tells me what to do next.
The setup wizard resets after step two and I have to reenter the same company settings.
Every assignment update sends an email and a push notification. It is impossible to focus.
We need one daily digest instead of five near-identical activity alerts per team.
Managers cannot mute low-priority reminders, so they are ignoring all notifications.
Please let me choose push only or email only. I do not need both for every event.
The product continues emailing resolved-ticket reminders a day after completion.
I can see total tickets but can’t find a breakdown by issue category in the analytics screen.
The weekly report is buried behind three menus and the export button is hard to discover.
Our team leaders need to filter dashboard results by region, not only by company-wide totals.
I wish charts explained what the trends mean; right now the dashboard is confusing.
We need to compare first-response times across teams without manually combining several reports.
Our invoice shows an add-on we did not recognize and I cannot find the price breakdown.
The renewal notification never explains how our seat count affects the next bill.
The pricing page lists two plans but fails to explain the overage charges.
Why did the trial convert to a paid plan? The notice should show the charge before renewal.
I need to see taxes and discounts separately when downloading invoices.
CRM contacts added yesterday are still missing in the support tool even though sync shows success.
Our CRM integration duplicates accounts every time we reconnect it.
Calendar appointments have stopped syncing and there is no error shown anywhere.
Data from our CRM arrives with yesterday’s owner assignments.
The API integration keeps failing intermittently with no actionable retry message.
On my phone, the Save button sits below the screen edge, so I cannot submit a reply.
The mobile text is too small for our field staff to read without zooming.
Our agents using screen readers cannot tell which field is required on the mobile form.
The mobile ticket list freezes when I turn on large text in accessibility settings.
Keyboard navigation through the mobile web form skips the attachment button entirely.

insights.summary: All five onboarding comments point to friction in reaching a successful first setup: unclear sequencing and next steps, insufficient role guidance, expiring invitations, and lost progress. The wizard reset and invitation expiry are direct completion blockers.
insights.pm_recommendation: Prioritize setup reliability first: preserve progress and entered settings across sessions, and make invitations renewable or configurable. Then add a guided, ordered checklist with contextual role/permission explanations and a clear next action on the welcome screen. Instrument setup-step completion and abandonment to measure impact.

insights.summary: Customers describe excessive, duplicated, low-priority, and stale alerts across email and push. The result is reduced focus and notification fatigue severe enough that managers ignore all notifications.
insights.pm_recommendation: Build notification preferences by event type and channel, including email-only/push-only controls, priority muting, and configurable digests. Suppress reminders immediately when a ticket is resolved and deduplicate equivalent events. Track notification opt-outs, mute rates, and engagement with actionable alerts.

insights.summary: Users can access headline totals but lack useful segmentation and comparison, while report discovery and chart interpretation are weak. This limits the dashboard’s value for operational decisions.
insights.pm_recommendation: Improve core analytical workflows with issue-category and region filters plus side-by-side team comparisons for first-response time. Make weekly reports and exports easier to find, and add concise chart labels or contextual explanations. Validate with task-based usability tests and measure report/export usage.

insights.summary: Billing feedback consistently signals low price transparency before and after purchase: unclear add-ons, seat-based renewal impact, overage rules, trial conversion charges, and invoice line items.
insights.pm_recommendation: Create a consistent billing breakdown across pricing, renewal notices, and invoices. Show add-on names and costs, seat-count assumptions, overage rates, taxes, discounts, and the expected renewal charge before conversion or renewal. Add a pre-renewal cost preview and test whether billing-related support contacts decline.

insights.summary: Integration trust is undermined by missing or stale records despite apparent success, duplicate accounts after reconnects, silent calendar failures, and intermittent API errors without recovery guidance.
insights.pm_recommendation: Make sync status reflect verified outcomes rather than job completion alone. Add record-level sync timestamps and error details, idempotent reconnect behavior to prevent duplicates, stale-data detection, and actionable retry/recovery controls. Monitor sync latency, failure rate, duplicate creation, and time to recovery.

insights.summary: Mobile workflows have both responsive-layout defects and accessibility barriers: controls fall off-screen, text is difficult to read, required fields are not announced, large-text settings cause freezes, and keyboard focus skips controls.
insights.pm_recommendation: Treat mobile accessibility as a release-quality requirement. Fix viewport and responsive control placement, support text scaling without freezing, expose programmatic required-field labels and errors for screen readers, and repair keyboard focus order. Add automated accessibility checks and manual testing across screen sizes, screen readers, large-text settings, and keyboard-only use.
